# Fastfile for the Fa app (flutter_app).
#
# TestFlight submit lanes, adapted 1:1 from learn.ai's deploy setup: builds
# happen in the CI workflows (flutter build ipa / flutter build macos), so
# these lanes only upload the produced artifacts with the App Store Connect
# API key from the environment:
#
# The daily's submit_only lanes distribute straight to the EXTERNAL
# TestFlight group (issue #239): the group name and Beta App Review contact
# ride repo variables (TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP, BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_*,
# BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL). release-appstore.yml drives the manual
# submit_for_review lanes (App Store review submission).
#   APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID / APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID /
#   APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT
#
# Android (#289): the build_only/build_release + upload_only lanes follow
# the same split against Google Play; the service-account JSON rides
# PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON and
# the track rides PLAY_TRACK (internal first, then external beta).
#
# iOS:    IOS_IPA_PATH points at the built .ipa (default: build/ios/*.ipa's
#         conventional location).
# macOS:  MACOS_PKG_PATH points at the signed .pkg (Mac Installer
#         Distribution cert) and MACOS_BUNDLE_ID overrides dev.fa1.app.

require_relative "appstore_preflight"
require_relative "play_listing_sync"
require_relative "play_upload_preflight"
require_relative "version_floor"

def asc_api_key
  app_store_connect_api_key(
    key_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID"],
    issuer_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID"],
    key_content: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT"],
    is_key_content_base64: false,
    in_house: false
  )
end

# App Store locale map for the store pipeline: fastlane/metadata folder →
# App Store Connect locale. Golden screenshots live one level below under
# the plain language code (test/goldens/store/<en|ru>/<ios|ipad|mac>).
def store_locale_map
  { "en-US" => "en-US", "ru-RU" => "ru" }
end

# Latest "## [version]" section of store_artefacts/metadata/<lang>/changelog.md.
def store_latest_changelog(lang)
  file_path = File.expand_path("../../store_artefacts/metadata/#{lang}/changelog.md", __dir__)
  return "" unless File.exist?(file_path)
  content = File.read(file_path)
  match = content.match(/## \[.*?\][^\n]*\n(.*?)(?=\n## \[|\z)/m)
  match ? match[1].strip : ""
end

def store_pubspec_version
  pubspec_path = File.expand_path("../pubspec.yaml", __dir__)
  return "1.0.0" unless File.exist?(pubspec_path)
  match = File.read(pubspec_path).match(/version:\s+([0-9.]+)/)
  match ? match[1] : "1.0.0"
end

# ── External TestFlight distribution (issue #239) ─────────────────────────
# A missing repo variable is a LOUD named failure at lane start (AC1) —
# never a fastlane stack trace mid-upload. The variables are set once as
# repo variables and passed through by build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml.
def require_env!(name, what)
  value = ENV[name].to_s.strip
  UI.user_error!("#{name} is not set — #{what}") if value.empty?
  value
end

def external_testflight_group!
  require_env!("TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP",
               "external TestFlight distribution needs the group name (create the 'External Beta' group in App Store Connect, then set the TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP repo variable)")
end

# Beta App Review contact (AC2): external distribution only flips green
# unattended when the review info is complete. The app is local-first —
# it boots without any account or key, so no demo account is required.
def beta_app_review_info!
  {
    contact_first_name: ENV.fetch("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_FIRST_NAME", "Uladzimir"),
    contact_last_name: ENV.fetch("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_LAST_NAME", "Klyshevich"),
    contact_email: require_env!("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL", "Beta App Review needs a contact email (set the BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL repo variable)"),
    contact_phone: require_env!("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE", "Beta App Review needs a contact phone (set the BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE repo variable)"),
    demo_account_required: false,
    notes: "Local-first AI agent app. No account, sign-in or API key is required — the app boots fully on-device with local models, so there is nothing to sign into."
  }
end

def beta_app_feedback_email!
  require_env!("BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL", "external TestFlight testing needs a feedback email (set the BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL repo variable)")
end

# distribute_external requires a "What to Test" changelog — pilot raises in
# non-interactive CI without one. Reuse the store release notes.
def testflight_changelog
  notes = store_latest_changelog("en")
  notes.empty? ? "Bug fixes and improvements." : notes
end

# Bounded wait for ASC processing (E1): external distribution needs a
# PROCESSED build — pilot silently SKIPS distribution when the wait is
# skipped. Default 90 min; override with TESTFLIGHT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
def testflight_wait_timeout
  seconds = ENV["TESTFLIGHT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"].to_i
  seconds.positive? ? seconds : 5400
end

def asc_token!
  require "spaceship"
  Spaceship::ConnectAPI.token ||= Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Token.create(
    key_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID"],
    issuer_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID"],
    key: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT"]
  )
end

def asc_app!(bundle_id:)
  require "spaceship"
  app = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::App.find(bundle_id)
  UI.user_error!("App #{bundle_id} not found in App Store Connect") if app.nil?
  app
end

# E3: pilot resolves groups BY NAME and silently skips adding the build when
# the name resolves to nothing — fail loudly instead, pointing at the
# variable. Returns [app, matched_group].
def find_external_testflight_group!(bundle_id:, group:)
  asc_token!
  app = asc_app!(bundle_id: bundle_id)
  found = app.get_beta_groups(includes: nil, limit: 200).select { |g| g.name == group }
  UI.user_error!("TestFlight external group '#{group}' (TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP) not found in App Store Connect — create it or fix the repo variable. Nothing was uploaded.") if found.empty?
  [app, found.first]
end

# gh-1041 (AC1): appearance is NO LONGER the submit leg's job — ASC
# read-side lag (group membership trailing an already-successful
# distribution, #855: run 36382214186 died in a 900s wait-loop while the
# build was in fact live) must never fail a green `upload_to_testflight`.
# After a successful upload ONE read-only probe runs, purely informational
# and unable to raise: found → ✅ line; not yet → a note pointing at the
# deferred store-appearance-check workflow, which re-checks the store
# 120 min after the legs start and files/updates exactly one stub if the
# version is still absent past the horizon. Leg success = upload success.
def verify_external_distribution!(bundle_id:, group:, app_version:)
  probe = lambda do
    app, beta_group = find_external_testflight_group!(bundle_id: bundle_id, group: group)
    group_build_ids = beta_group.fetch_builds.map(&:id)
    build = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Build.all(
      app_id: app.id,
      includes: "preReleaseVersion,buildBetaDetail",
      processing_states: "VALID",
      sort: "-uploadedDate",
      limit: 100
    ).select { |b| b.app_version == app_version && group_build_ids.include?(b.id) }
     .max_by { |b| b.version.to_i }
    if build
      # fastlane deleted BuildBetaDetail#ready_for_external_testing? but left
      # Build#ready_for_external_testing? calling it — NoMethodError the
      # moment ASC returns buildBetaDetail (issue #362; green runs only saw
      # nil, which short-circuits). Read external_build_state from the beta
      # detail directly: IN_BETA_TESTING/BETA_APPROVED = live, anything else
      # (incl. nil detail) = still waiting for Beta App Review.
      external_state = build.build_beta_detail&.external_build_state
      if external_state == "IN_BETA_TESTING" || external_state == "BETA_APPROVED"
        UI.success("✅ #{app_version} (build #{build.version}) is live to the external group '#{group}' — distributed with zero clicks")
      else
        UI.important("Build #{app_version} (#{build.version}) is in '#{group}' and waiting for Beta App Review — external visibility flips automatically on approval, no clicks needed.")
      end
    else
      UI.important("Build #{app_version} not visible in '#{group}' yet — the submit stays GREEN (gh-1041: store read-side lag is not a failure). The deferred store-appearance-check workflow re-checks ASC 120 min after the daily legs start and files/updates one stub if the version is still absent past the horizon.")
    end
  end
  begin
    probe.call
  rescue StandardError => e
    UI.important("Post-submit appearance probe skipped (#{e.class}: #{e.message.to_s[0, 160]}) — the upload above already succeeded; the deferred store-appearance-check workflow owns appearance verification (gh-1041, #855).")
  end
end

# Read-only ASC facts for one platform → AppstorePreflight decision (AC3:
# every check happens BEFORE any mutation).
def appstore_submission_decision(bundle_id:, platform:, version:, confirm:)
  app = asc_app!(bundle_id: bundle_id)
  app_store_version = app
                      .get_app_store_versions(filter: { platform: platform })
                      .find { |v| v.version_string == version }
  builds = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Build.all(
    app_id: app.id,
    version: version,
    platform: platform,
    processing_states: "PROCESSING,VALID,FAILED,INVALID"
  )
  decision = AppstorePreflight.decide(
    version: version,
    confirm: confirm,
    app_store_version: app_store_version && { "state" => app_store_version.app_store_state },
    builds: builds.map { |b| { "number" => b.version, "state" => b.processing_state } }
  )
  [app, decision]
end

def store_summary_line(line)
  path = ENV["GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"]
  File.write(path, "#{line}\n", mode: "a") if path
  UI.success(line)
end

# Builds a temp metadata dir for deliver from fastlane/metadata/<platform_key>/
# with App Store locale names, release_notes.txt from the store_artefacts
# changelogs (en fallback per locale), and WITHOUT name.txt/subtitle.txt —
# App Info is not editable once the app is released, and deliver would fail.
def build_store_metadata_dir(platform_key:, out_dir:)
  FileUtils.rm_rf(out_dir)
  FileUtils.mkdir_p(out_dir)
  store_locale_map.each do |src_locale, as_locale|
    src = "metadata/#{platform_key}/#{src_locale}"
    FileUtils.cp_r(src, "#{out_dir}/#{as_locale}") if Dir.exist?(src)
  end
  en_notes = store_latest_changelog("en")
  ru_notes = store_latest_changelog("ru")
  store_locale_map.each_value do |as_locale|
    dir = "#{out_dir}/#{as_locale}"
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
    notes = as_locale == "ru" && !ru_notes.empty? ? ru_notes : en_notes
    File.write("#{dir}/release_notes.txt", notes)
    FileUtils.rm_f("#{dir}/name.txt")
    FileUtils.rm_f("#{dir}/subtitle.txt")
  end
end

# Copies committed store goldens (flutter_app/test/goldens/store/<lang>/<device>)
# into the deliver screenshots folder with App Store locale names, falling
# back to English when a locale has no localized screenshots.
def copy_store_screenshots(device:, suffix:, out_root:)
  goldens = File.expand_path("../test/goldens/store", __dir__)
  store_locale_map.each do |src_locale, as_locale|
    lang = src_locale.split("-").first.downcase
    dir = "#{out_root}/#{as_locale}"
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
    files = Dir.glob("#{goldens}/#{lang}/#{device}/*.png").sort.first(10)
    if files.empty?
      files = Dir.glob("#{goldens}/en/#{device}/*.png").sort.first(10)
      UI.message("No #{device} screenshots for #{as_locale}, using en fallback") unless files.empty?
    end
    files.each do |f|
      FileUtils.cp(f, "#{dir}/#{File.basename(f, ".*")}#{suffix}.png")
    end
  end
end

# Apple's Connect API 500s in bursts (even seconds apart on identical
# requests) — retry the block a few times on "Server error got 500".
def with_apple_retries(attempts: 3, delay: 25)
  tries = 0
  begin
    tries += 1
    yield
  rescue => e
    if e.message.include?("Server error got 500") && tries < attempts
      UI.important("Apple API 500 (attempt #{tries}/#{attempts}) — retrying in #{delay}s...")
      sleep(delay)
      retry
    end
    raise
  end
end

# Directly updates App Store version localizations via the Spaceship API.
# Fallback when deliver fails because App Info is not editable.
def upload_version_metadata_via_api(metadata_dir:, bundle_id:, platform:)
  require "spaceship"

  app = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::App.find(bundle_id)
  if app.nil?
    UI.error("Could not find app with bundle_id: #{bundle_id}")
    return
  end

  version = app.get_edit_app_store_version(platform: platform)
  if version.nil?
    UI.important("No editable version found for #{bundle_id} on #{platform} - skipping")
    return
  end

  locs = version.get_app_store_version_localizations
  updated = 0
  locs.each do |loc|
    locale_dir = File.join(metadata_dir, loc.locale)
    attrs = {}
    {
      "release_notes"    => :whatsNew,
      "description"      => :description,
      "keywords"         => :keywords,
      "promotional_text" => :promotionalText
    }.each do |file_name, attr_key|
      file_path = File.join(locale_dir, "#{file_name}.txt")
      attrs[attr_key] = File.read(file_path).strip if File.exist?(file_path)
    end
    unless attrs.empty?
      loc.update(attributes: attrs)
      updated += 1
    end
  end
  UI.success("Updated #{updated} locale(s) version metadata via Spaceship API")
end

platform :ios do
  # gh-798 AC1/AC2: the daily TestFlight leg asserts the version it is
  # about to stamp is strictly ABOVE the latest ASC-approved version BEFORE
  # any build runs — #785's failure class (altool 90062 at the end of a
  # 20-minute build) dies here in seconds instead. Reads the SAME version
  # source the build stamps (BUILD_NAME — pubspec → tag → version job, the
  # one-version scheme gh-785 centralized). The decision lives in
  # version_floor.rb (plain-ruby tested); this lane only fetches ASC facts.
  desc "Assert the stamped version is above the ASC-approved floor before building (gh-798)"
  lane :assert_version_floor do
    stamped = ENV["BUILD_NAME"].to_s.strip
    UI.user_error!("[gh-798] BUILD_NAME is not set — the version-floor pre-check needs the version the build will stamp") if stamped.empty?

    if ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT"].to_s.strip.empty?
      # ASC keys are optional repo secrets: without them the submit leg
      # skips the upload anyway, so there is no floor to guard. The skip
      # stays a visible marker, never a silent pass (gh-798 AC4).
      UI.important("[gh-798] version-floor pre-check: SKIPPED — no APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT secret (the upload leg would skip too)")
      next
    end

    bundle_id = ENV["IOS_BUNDLE_ID"] || "dev.fa1.app"
    # E1: ASC unreachable/rate-limited gets exactly one retry, then a
    # fail-closed named error — a skipped floor check is a silent floor.
    tries = 0
    begin
      tries += 1
      asc_token!
      app = asc_app!(bundle_id: bundle_id)
      approved = app.get_app_store_versions(filter: { platform: Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Platform::IOS }).map do |v|
        { "state" => v.app_store_state, "version" => v.version_string }
      end
    rescue FastlaneCore::Interface::FastlaneError
      # gh-800 r2: deterministic lane errors (missing ASC app, missing
      # TestFlight group, any UI.user_error!) are NOT transient — re-raise
      # immediately instead of retrying them and mislabeling the failure
      # "App Store Connect unreachable".
      raise
    rescue StandardError => e
      retry if tries < 2
      UI.user_error!("[gh-798] version-floor pre-check: App Store Connect unreachable after one retry (#{e.class}: #{e.message.to_s[0, 200]}) — failing closed: cannot verify the version floor, refusing to build")
    end

    decision = VersionFloor.decide(stamped: stamped, approved: approved)
    # AC4 leg-level marker: the pre-check RAN and what it decided — visible
    # in the daily report, so a silently-skipped check can never hide.
    UI.message("[gh-798] version-floor pre-check RAN: stamped=#{stamped} approved_floor=#{decision['floor']} verdict=#{decision['action']}")
    UI.user_error!(decision["reason"]) if decision["action"] == "abort"
    UI.success("✅ #{decision['reason']}")
  end

  desc "Build iOS IPA only (for CI split build/submit pattern)"
  lane :build_only do
    # The CI workflow creates and unlocks build.keychain before calling this lane.
    if File.exist?(File.expand_path("~/Library/Keychains/build.keychain-db"))
      sh("security list-keychains -d user -s #{Dir.home}/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db #{Dir.home}/Library/Keychains/build.keychain-db")
      sh("security unlock-keychain -p '' #{Dir.home}/Library/Keychains/build.keychain-db")
      sh("security default-keychain -d user -s #{Dir.home}/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db")
    else
      sh("security list-keychains -d user -s #{Dir.home}/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db")
    end

    team_id = ENV["IOS_TEAM_ID"] || "YP9HC3USZ3"
    bundle_id = ENV["IOS_BUNDLE_ID"] || "dev.fa1.app"
    profile_name = ENV["IOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_NAME"] || "Fa Profile"
    live_activity_profile_name = ENV["IOS_LIVE_ACTIVITY_PROFILE_NAME"] || "FaLiveActivity Profile"
    signing_identity = ENV["IOS_SIGNING_IDENTITY"] || "iPhone Distribution"

    update_code_signing_settings(
      use_automatic_signing: false,
      path: "ios/Runner.xcodeproj",
      team_id: team_id,
      bundle_identifier: bundle_id,
      profile_name: profile_name,
      code_sign_identity: signing_identity,
      # ONLY the app target: without this filter the action rewrites EVERY
      # target's PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER (incl. the FaLiveActivity
      # extension), producing a CFBundleIdentifier collision at upload.
      targets: ["Runner"]
    )

    # The FaLiveActivity extension signs MANUALLY as well: the runner's Xcode
    # has no Apple account, so automatic signing / -allowProvisioningUpdates
    # cannot create its profile — it is installed from a secret by the
    # workflow and only gets pointed at here.
    update_code_signing_settings(
      use_automatic_signing: false,
      path: "ios/Runner.xcodeproj",
      team_id: team_id,
      bundle_identifier: "#{bundle_id}.FaLiveActivity",
      profile_name: live_activity_profile_name,
      code_sign_identity: signing_identity,
      targets: ["FaLiveActivity"]
    )

    sh("flutter", "clean")
    sh("flutter", "pub", "get")
    cocoapods(podfile: "ios/Podfile")

    if ENV["BUILD_NUMBER"]
      increment_build_number(xcodeproj: "ios/Runner.xcodeproj", build_number: ENV["BUILD_NUMBER"])
    else
      increment_build_number(xcodeproj: "ios/Runner.xcodeproj")
    end

    # Issue #726 (run 35564638018): ASC closes a version train once a build
    # of it was approved (90186) and rejects submissions not higher than the
    # previously approved version (90062) — with pubspec pinned at 1.0.0 the
    # daily TestFlight upload can never land again. BUILD_NAME comes from
    # build-mobile.yml (the derived next-tag version, strictly increasing);
    # unset = legacy manual flow, keep the pubspec version.
    build_name_args = ENV["BUILD_NAME"] ? ["--build-name", ENV["BUILD_NAME"]] : []
    sh("xcrun simctl list > /dev/null 2>&1 || true")
    sh("xcrun simctl boot 'iPhone 16' 2>/dev/null || xcrun simctl boot 'iPhone 15' 2>/dev/null || true")
    sh("flutter", "build", "ios", "--release", "--no-codesign", *build_name_args)

    build_app(
      workspace: "ios/Runner.xcworkspace",
      scheme: "Runner",
      export_method: "app-store",
      output_directory: "build/ios/ipa",
      output_name: "fa.ipa",
      skip_build_archive: false,
      clean: true,
      sdk: "iphoneos",
      export_options: {
        method: "app-store",
        provisioningProfiles: {
          bundle_id => profile_name,
          "#{bundle_id}.FaLiveActivity" => live_activity_profile_name
        },
        signingStyle: "manual",
        teamID: team_id,
        manageAppVersionAndBuildNumber: false,
        uploadBitcode: false,
        compileBitcode: false
      },
      export_xcargs: "-allowProvisioningUpdates"
    )
  end

  desc "Upload the built IPA to TestFlight and distribute to the external group (no metadata/screenshots)"
  lane :submit_only do
    ipa = ENV["IOS_IPA_PATH"] || File.expand_path("../build/ios/ipa/fa.ipa", __dir__)
    UI.user_error!("IPA not found: #{ipa} (set IOS_IPA_PATH)") unless File.exist?(ipa)

    # Loud named failures at lane start (AC1) — a missing variable must
    # never surface as a fastlane stack trace after the upload.
    group = external_testflight_group!
    review_info = beta_app_review_info!
    feedback_email = beta_app_feedback_email!
    bundle_id = ENV["IOS_BUNDLE_ID"] || "dev.fa1.app"
    find_external_testflight_group!(bundle_id: bundle_id, group: group)

    upload_to_testflight(
      api_key: [REDACTED:Sensitive Value],
      ipa: ipa,
      # External distribution needs a PROCESSED build: skipping the wait
      # makes pilot silently skip distribution (bounded, E1).
      skip_waiting_for_build_processing: false,
      wait_processing_timeout_duration: testflight_wait_timeout,
      distribute_external: true,
      groups: [group],
      notify_external_testers: true,
      changelog: testflight_changelog,
      beta_app_review_info: review_info,
      beta_app_feedback_email: feedback_email,
      uses_non_exempt_encryption: false
    )

    # Select the uploaded build by the marketing version it actually ships
    # (BUILD_NAME when the build lane set it, issue #726; pubspec otherwise).
    verify_external_distribution!(bundle_id: bundle_id, group: group, app_version: ENV["BUILD_NAME"] || store_pubspec_version)
  end

  desc "Submit the version's latest processed TestFlight build to App Store review (release-appstore.yml)"
  lane :submit_for_review do
    version = require_env!("APP_STORE_VERSION", "the app version to submit, e.g. 1.2.3")
    confirm = require_env!("APP_STORE_CONFIRM", "must repeat the version string exactly (fat-finger guard)")
    # E5: flipping to automatic release stays a one-line repo variable.
    automatic_release = ENV.fetch("APP_STORE_AUTOMATIC_RELEASE", "false") == "true"
    bundle_id = ENV["IOS_BUNDLE_ID"] || "dev.fa1.app"

    asc_token!
    app, decision = appstore_submission_decision(bundle_id: bundle_id, platform: Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Platform::IOS, version: version, confirm: confirm)
    UI.user_error!(decision["reason"]) if decision["action"] == "fail"
    if decision["action"] == "noop"
      UI.success("ℹ️ #{decision['reason']}")
      next
    end

    UI.message("#{decision['reason']} (automatic_release=#{automatic_release})")
    deliver(
      app_identifier: bundle_id,

# ── Android / Play (issue #289) ───────────────────────────────────────────
# Mirrors the iOS split: the build lane produces the release AAB from the
# CI secrets (the upload keystore rides ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 et al. and
# is decoded by app/build.gradle.kts — see the release signingConfig), the
# upload lane ships it to Google Play. Track policy: the FIRST real upload
# goes to the internal track (owner, one-time console step — Play App
# Signing enrollment may also require the console UI); afterwards the
# daily-publish Play leg publishes to the external beta (open testing)
# track via PLAY_TRACK=beta. Every decision routes through
# play_upload_preflight.rb so the lane logic is testable without the Play
# API (fastlane/test/play_upload_preflight_test.rb).
platform :android do
  desc "Build the release AAB only (CI split build/submit pattern; #289 build_release)"
  lane :build_release do
    sh("flutter", "pub", "get")
    if ENV["BUILD_NUMBER"]
      sh("flutter", "build", "appbundle", "--release", "--flavor", "store", "--build-number=#{ENV['BUILD_NUMBER']}")
    else
      sh("flutter", "build", "appbundle", "--release", "--flavor", "store")
    end
    aab = PlayUploadPreflight.default_aab_path(File.expand_path("..", __dir__))
    UI.user_error!("AAB not found at #{aab} after the build") unless File.exist?(aab)
    UI.success("Release AAB built: #{aab}")
  end

  desc "Alias of build_release — keeps the iOS `build_only` lane name so `fastlane android build_only` works"
  lane :build_only do
    build_release
  end

  desc "Upload the built AAB to Google Play (upload_to_play_store). PLAY_TRACK selects internal/alpha/beta/production (default internal); PLAY_VALIDATE_ONLY=1 authenticates and resolves the track without publishing"
  lane :upload_only do
    repo_root = File.expand_path("..", __dir__)
    json_key = PlayUploadPreflight.play_json_key!(ENV)
    track = PlayUploadPreflight.track!(ENV)
    aab = PlayUploadPreflight.aab_path!(ENV, repo_root: repo_root)
    validate_only = PlayUploadPreflight.validate_only?(ENV)

    package_name = PlayUploadPreflight.package_name!(repo_root)
    UI.message("Play upload: track=#{track} aab=#{aab} validate_only=#{validate_only} " \
               "package=#{package_name}")
    upload_to_play_store(
      PlayUploadPreflight
        .supply_options(track: track, aab: aab, validate_only: validate_only)
        .merge(json_key_data: json_key,
               package_name: package_name)
    )
    if validate_only
      UI.success("✅ Play validate-only pass: authenticated, track '#{track}' + #{File.basename(aab)} resolved — nothing published")
    else
      store_summary_line("Android #{store_pubspec_version} uploaded to the Play '#{track}' track — #{File.basename(aab)}")
    end
  end

  desc "Deploy the Google Play store listing (metadata + images + screenshots, no binary). PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA=false skips texts, PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES=false skips icon/featureGraphic/screenshots, PLAY_VALIDATE_ONLY=1 authenticates and resolves the track without uploading"
  lane :play_store do
    # The store-listing half of the Android release (issue #289), the
    # supply twin of the iOS/mac `app_store` lanes: the texts live in
    # fastlane/metadata/android/<locale>/ and the images are COMMITTED
    # GOLDENS rendered by test/golden/store_screenshots_test.dart and
    # test/golden/play_store_assets_test.dart (sizes enforced by
    # test/play_store_listing_guard_test.dart). Never a binary — AABs ride
    # upload_only — and never changelogs (Play release notes need a
    # version code and belong to the binary upload).
    #
    # Issue #947: supply only APPENDS screenshot uploads, which is how the
    # old "The first…" screenshot survived on the live listing after the
    # repo goldens were fixed. The images go through PlayListingSync: the
    # whole set is replaced per locale + device type (stale shots deleted,
    # ru-RU tenInch and other dropped sets cleared) and the committed
    # state is verified via edits.images.list — a mismatch fails the lane.
    #
    # gh-1402 (owner steering) — App-token rule for the release path: any
    # automation that commits/pushes release-path changes (store metadata
    # fixes, version bumps, changelogs) MUST use the fa-release-bot GitHub
    # App token (the #1172 ruleset-bypass machinery) — never a PAT, never
    # the default GITHUB_TOKEN: main's required status checks reject both
    # (#1098).
    #
    # gh-1402 pre-flight, the lane's first step: the LOCAL
    # language-completeness gate — every metadata/android/<lang>/ must
    # carry non-empty title/short_description/full_description before any
    # network call. Google rejects a listing edit AT COMMIT (HTTP 403
    # "This app has no title for language ru-RU", 2026-10-08) when a
    # touched language is untitled; the gate never lets Google say it
    # first, and sync_and_verify! additionally skips store-side listings
    # that have no title (the texts deploy below creates/completes them).
    PlayListingSync.validate_listing_completeness!(
      File.expand_path("metadata/android", __dir__)
    )
    do_metadata = ENV.fetch("PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA", "true") == "true"
    do_images = ENV.fetch("PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES", "true") == "true"
    repo_root = File.expand_path("..", __dir__)
    track = PlayUploadPreflight.track!(ENV)
    validate_only = PlayUploadPreflight.validate_only?(ENV)
    json_key = PlayUploadPreflight.play_json_key!(ENV)
    package_name = PlayUploadPreflight.package_name!(repo_root)
    UI.message("Play store listing deploy: metadata=#{do_metadata}, images=#{do_images}, track=#{track}, validate_only=#{validate_only}")

    if do_images && !validate_only
      store_summary_line(
        PlayListingSync.sync_and_verify!(
          metadata_dir: File.expand_path("metadata/android", __dir__),
          json_key: json_key,
          package_name: package_name
        )
      )
    end
    upload_to_play_store(
      PlayUploadPreflight
        .supply_listing_options(
          track: track, metadata: do_metadata, images: do_images,
          validate_only: validate_only
        )
        .merge(json_key_data: json_key,
               package_name: package_name)
    )
    if validate_only
      UI.success("✅ Play listing validate-only pass: authenticated, track '#{track}' resolved — nothing uploaded")
    else
      store_summary_line("Google Play store listing updated (metadata=#{do_metadata}, images=#{do_images})")
    end
  end
end

# gh-1519: [BUG] Store pipeline cannot create an App Store version: store-metadata runs deliver with skip_app_version_update=true, release-appstore pre-flight dead-ends (v1.0.548 needed manual ASC)

## Description

## Symptom (release v1.0.548, 2026-10-10)

Full release required MANUAL owner intervention: `release-appstore.yml` pre-flight failed 4× with "App Store version 1.0.548 does not exist yet — run store-metadata.yml (metadata_only) first. Nothing was mutated." — but running store-metadata.yml (both legs green) did NOT create the version. Owner created the App Store version by hand in the ASC UI and submitted manually.

## Root cause

The pipeline has NO step that creates a new App Store version:

- `store-metadata.yml` → fastlane `app_store` lane runs `deliver(app_version: store_pubspec_version, skip_app_version_update: true, …)` — the `skip_app_version_update: true` flag tells deliver to never create/update the version record (Fastfile.swift-equivalent at flutter_app/fastlane/Fastfile:554). The run log confirms: "Uploading metadata to App Store Connect for version" with an EMPTY version string.
- `release-appstore.yml` pre-flight (`appstore_submission_decision`, Fastfile:186) correctly refuses when the version is absent — but the remediation it prints is wrong: store-metadata cannot satisfy it.

So the documented remediation loop (`run store-metadata first`) is a dead end; every new version needs a manual ASC click.

## Requirement

1. store-metadata's metadata lanes must CREATE the version when absent: drop `skip_app_version_update: true` (or add an explicit ASC `appStoreVersions` POST via Spaceship before deliver) so `app_version` actually materializes the version record. Applies to both iOS and macOS lanes.
2. Keep the release-appstore pre-flight as-is (it caught the hole correctly) but fix its printed remediation to name the creating step.
3. Verify read-side: after creation, `get_app_store_versions(filter: { platform: })` must find the new version — if ASC read lag/pagination hides freshly created versions, add a bounded retry to the pre-flight rather than an instant fail.

## Acceptance

- Fresh version end-to-end unattended: build-mobile (TF) → store-metadata → release-appstore submits for review with zero manual ASC clicks (release-after-approval stays manual per E5).
- REG: re-running store-metadata on an EXISTING version stays idempotent (metadata update only, no duplicate version error).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

# Fastfile for the Fa app (flutter_app).
#
# TestFlight submit lanes, adapted 1:1 from learn.ai's deploy setup: builds
# happen in the CI workflows (flutter build ipa / flutter build macos), so
# these lanes only upload the produced artifacts with the App Store Connect
# API key from the environment:
#
# The daily's submit_only lanes distribute straight to the EXTERNAL
# TestFlight group (issue #239): the group name and Beta App Review contact
# ride repo variables (TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP, BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_*,
# BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL). release-appstore.yml drives the manual
# submit_for_review lanes (App Store review submission).
#   APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID / APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID /
#   APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT
#
# Android (#289): the build_only/build_release + upload_only lanes follow
# the same split against Google Play; the service-account JSON rides
# PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON and
# the track rides PLAY_TRACK (internal first, then external beta).
#
# iOS:    IOS_IPA_PATH points at the built .ipa (default: build/ios/*.ipa's
#         conventional location).
# macOS:  MACOS_PKG_PATH points at the signed .pkg (Mac Installer
#         Distribution cert) and MACOS_BUNDLE_ID overrides dev.fa1.app.

require_relative "appstore_preflight"
require_relative "play_listing_sync"
require_relative "play_upload_preflight"
require_relative "version_floor"

def asc_api_key
  app_store_connect_api_key(
    key_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID"],
    issuer_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID"],
    key_content: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT"],
    is_key_content_base64: false,
    in_house: false
  )
end

# App Store locale map for the store pipeline: fastlane/metadata folder →
# App Store Connect locale. Golden screenshots live one level below under
# the plain language code (test/goldens/store/<en|ru>/<ios|ipad|mac>).
def store_locale_map
  { "en-US" => "en-US", "ru-RU" => "ru" }
end

# Latest "## [version]" section of store_artefacts/metadata/<lang>/changelog.md.
def store_latest_changelog(lang)
  file_path = File.expand_path("../../store_artefacts/metadata/#{lang}/changelog.md", __dir__)
  return "" unless File.exist?(file_path)
  content = File.read(file_path)
  match = content.match(/## \[.*?\][^\n]*\n(.*?)(?=\n## \[|\z)/m)
  match ? match[1].strip : ""
end

def store_pubspec_version
  pubspec_path = File.expand_path("../pubspec.yaml", __dir__)
  return "1.0.0" unless File.exist?(pubspec_path)
  match = File.read(pubspec_path).match(/version:\s+([0-9.]+)/)
  match ? match[1] : "1.0.0"
end

# ── External TestFlight distribution (issue #239) ─────────────────────────
# A missing repo variable is a LOUD named failure at lane start (AC1) —
# never a fastlane stack trace mid-upload. The variables are set once as
# repo variables and passed through by build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml.
def require_env!(name, what)
  value = ENV[name].to_s.strip
  UI.user_error!("#{name} is not set — #{what}") if value.empty?
  value
end

def external_testflight_group!
  require_env!("TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP",
               "external TestFlight distribution needs the group name (create the 'External Beta' group in App Store Connect, then set the TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP repo variable)")
end

# Beta App Review contact (AC2): external distribution only flips green
# unattended when the review info is complete. The app is local-first —
# it boots without any account or key, so no demo account is required.
def beta_app_review_info!
  {
    contact_first_name: ENV.fetch("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_FIRST_NAME", "Uladzimir"),
    contact_last_name: ENV.fetch("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_LAST_NAME", "Klyshevich"),
    contact_email: require_env!("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL", "Beta App Review needs a contact email (set the BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL repo variable)"),
    contact_phone: require_env!("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE", "Beta App Review needs a contact phone (set the BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE repo variable)"),
    demo_account_required: false,
    notes: "Local-first AI agent app. No account, sign-in or API key is required — the app boots fully on-device with local models, so there is nothing to sign into."
  }
end

def beta_app_feedback_email!
  require_env!("BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL", "external TestFlight testing needs a feedback email (set the BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL repo variable)")
end

# distribute_external requires a "What to Test" changelog — pilot raises in
# non-interactive CI without one. Reuse the store release notes.
def testflight_changelog
  notes = store_latest_changelog("en")
  notes.empty? ? "Bug fixes and improvements." : notes
end

# Bounded wait for ASC processing (E1): external distribution needs a
# PROCESSED build — pilot silently SKIPS distribution when the wait is
# skipped. Default 90 min; override with TESTFLIGHT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
def testflight_wait_timeout
  seconds = ENV["TESTFLIGHT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"].to_i
  seconds.positive? ? seconds : 5400
end

def asc_token!
  require "spaceship"
  Spaceship::ConnectAPI.token ||= Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Token.create(
    key_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID"],
    issuer_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID"],
    key: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT"]
  )
end

def asc_app!(bundle_id:)
  require "spaceship"
  app = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::App.find(bundle_id)
  UI.user_error!("App #{bundle_id} not found in App Store Connect") if app.nil?
  app
end

# E3: pilot resolves groups BY NAME and silently skips adding the build when
# the name resolves to nothing — fail loudly instead, pointing at the
# variable. Returns [app, matched_group].
def find_external_testflight_group!(bundle_id:, group:)
  asc_token!
  app = asc_app!(bundle_id: bundle_id)
  found = app.get_beta_groups(includes: nil, limit: 200).select { |g| g.name == group }

# frozen_string_literal: true

# Pure pre-flight decision logic for the manual App Store review submission
# (release-appstore.yml, issue #239 AC3). Deliberately dependency-free — no
# fastlane/spaceship requires: the Fastfile lane fetches the ASC facts, this
# module decides, so the whole matrix is testable with plain ruby
# (test/appstore_preflight_test.rb — no gems needed).
module AppstorePreflight
  # App Store version states where the version is already in review, or
  # approved and pending/released: a re-run must be a green no-op, never a
  # duplicate submission (AC3 idempotency, E2). Rejected states are NOT
  # listed — a rejected version may legitimately be resubmitted.
  SUBMITTED_STATES = %w[
    WAITING_FOR_REVIEW
    IN_REVIEW
    PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE
    READY_FOR_SALE
    ACCEPTED
  ].freeze

  # Fat-finger guard: the workflow's `confirm` input must repeat `version`
  # exactly (AC3). Returns the fail decision with a named reason — the lane
  # surfaces it via UI.user_error!, no stack trace, nothing mutated.
  def self.confirm_mismatch?(version:, confirm:)
    confirm != version
  end

  # facts:
  #   version           String, e.g. "1.2.3"
  #   confirm           Workflow `confirm` input — must repeat `version` exactly
  #   app_store_version nil, or { "state" => AppStoreState string }
  #   builds            Array of { "number" => build number string,
  #                               "state"  => "PROCESSING"|"VALID"|"FAILED"|"INVALID" }
  # Returns a decision Hash:
  #   { "action" => "fail",   "reason" => why, "build_number" => nil } — fail BEFORE any mutation
  #   { "action" => "noop",   "reason" => why, "build_number" => nil } — green no-op notice
  #   { "action" => "submit", "reason" => why, "build_number" => n }   — latest processed build
  def self.decide(version:, confirm:, app_store_version:, builds:)
    if confirm_mismatch?(version: version, confirm: confirm)
      return fail_decision("CONFIRM MISMATCH: confirm (#{confirm.inspect}) does not equal version (#{version.inspect}) — aborting before any mutation")
    end
    if app_store_version.nil?
      return fail_decision("App Store version #{version} does not exist yet — run store-metadata.yml (metadata_only) first so the version exists. Nothing was mutated.")
    end
    if builds.empty?
      return fail_decision("No TestFlight build exists for version #{version} — dispatch build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml first. Nothing was mutated.")
    end

    ready = builds.select { |b| b["state"] == "VALID" }
    if ready.empty?
      states = builds.map { |b| b["state"] }.tally.map { |s, n| "#{n} #{s}" }.join(", ")
      return fail_decision("Build(s) for version #{version} are still processing (#{states}) — Apple usually needs 5-30 min; re-run in ~15 minutes. Nothing was mutated.")
    end
    if SUBMITTED_STATES.include?(app_store_version["state"])
      return noop("Version #{version} is already submitted (App Store state #{app_store_version['state']}) — green no-op, nothing re-submitted")
    end

    build_number = ready.map { |b| b["number"].to_i }.max.to_s
    submit("Submitting #{version} (build #{build_number}, latest processed) for App Store review", build_number)
  end

  def self.fail_decision(reason)
    { "action" => "fail", "reason" => reason, "build_number" => nil }
  end

  def self.noop(reason)
    { "action" => "noop", "reason" => reason, "build_number" => nil }
  end

  def self.submit(reason, build_number)
    { "action" => "submit", "reason" => reason, "build_number" => build_number }
  end
end

# gh-1519: [BUG] Store pipeline cannot create an App Store version: store-metadata runs deliver with skip_app_version_update=true, release-appstore pre-flight dead-ends (v1.0.548 needed manual ASC)

## Description

## Symptom (release v1.0.548, 2026-10-10)

Full release required MANUAL owner intervention: `release-appstore.yml` pre-flight failed 4× with "App Store version 1.0.548 does not exist yet — run store-metadata.yml (metadata_only) first. Nothing was mutated." — but running store-metadata.yml (both legs green) did NOT create the version. Owner created the App Store version by hand in the ASC UI and submitted manually.

## Root cause

The pipeline has NO step that creates a new App Store version:

- `store-metadata.yml` → fastlane `app_store` lane runs `deliver(app_version: store_pubspec_version, skip_app_version_update: true, …)` — the `skip_app_version_update: true` flag tells deliver to never create/update the version record (Fastfile.swift-equivalent at flutter_app/fastlane/Fastfile:554). The run log confirms: "Uploading metadata to App Store Connect for version" with an EMPTY version string.
- `release-appstore.yml` pre-flight (`appstore_submission_decision`, Fastfile:186) correctly refuses when the version is absent — but the remediation it prints is wrong: store-metadata cannot satisfy it.

So the documented remediation loop (`run store-metadata first`) is a dead end; every new version needs a manual ASC click.

## Requirement

1. store-metadata's metadata lanes must CREATE the version when absent: drop `skip_app_version_update: true` (or add an explicit ASC `appStoreVersions` POST via Spaceship before deliver) so `app_version` actually materializes the version record. Applies to both iOS and macOS lanes.
2. Keep the release-appstore pre-flight as-is (it caught the hole correctly) but fix its printed remediation to name the creating step.
3. Verify read-side: after creation, `get_app_store_versions(filter: { platform: })` must find the new version — if ASC read lag/pagination hides freshly created versions, add a bounded retry to the pre-flight rather than an instant fail.

## Acceptance

- Fresh version end-to-end unattended: build-mobile (TF) → store-metadata → release-appstore submits for review with zero manual ASC clicks (release-after-approval stays manual per E5).
- REG: re-running store-metadata on an EXISTING version stays idempotent (metadata update only, no duplicate version error).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed

# Fastfile for the Fa app (flutter_app).
#
# TestFlight submit lanes, adapted 1:1 from learn.ai's deploy setup: builds
# happen in the CI workflows (flutter build ipa / flutter build macos), so
# these lanes only upload the produced artifacts with the App Store Connect
# API key from the environment:
#
# The daily's submit_only lanes distribute straight to the EXTERNAL
# TestFlight group (issue #239): the group name and Beta App Review contact
# ride repo variables (TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP, BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_*,
# BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL). release-appstore.yml drives the manual
# submit_for_review lanes (App Store review submission).
#   APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID / APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID /
#   APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT
#
# Android (#289): the build_only/build_release + upload_only lanes follow
# the same split against Google Play; the service-account JSON rides
# PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON and
# the track rides PLAY_TRACK (internal first, then external beta).
#
# iOS:    IOS_IPA_PATH points at the built .ipa (default: build/ios/*.ipa's
#         conventional location).
# macOS:  MACOS_PKG_PATH points at the signed .pkg (Mac Installer
#         Distribution cert) and MACOS_BUNDLE_ID overrides dev.fa1.app.

require_relative "appstore_preflight"
require_relative "play_listing_sync"
require_relative "play_upload_preflight"
require_relative "version_floor"

def asc_api_key
  app_store_connect_api_key(
    key_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID"],
    issuer_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID"],
    key_content: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT"],
    is_key_content_base64: false,
    in_house: false
  )
end

# App Store locale map for the store pipeline: fastlane/metadata folder →
# App Store Connect locale. Golden screenshots live one level below under
# the plain language code (test/goldens/store/<en|ru>/<ios|ipad|mac>).
def store_locale_map
  { "en-US" => "en-US", "ru-RU" => "ru" }
end

# Latest "## [version]" section of store_artefacts/metadata/<lang>/changelog.md.
def store_latest_changelog(lang)
  file_path = File.expand_path("../../store_artefacts/metadata/#{lang}/changelog.md", __dir__)
  return "" unless File.exist?(file_path)
  content = File.read(file_path)
  match = content.match(/## \[.*?\][^\n]*\n(.*?)(?=\n## \[|\z)/m)
  match ? match[1].strip : ""
end

def store_pubspec_version
  pubspec_path = File.expand_path("../pubspec.yaml", __dir__)
  return "1.0.0" unless File.exist?(pubspec_path)
  match = File.read(pubspec_path).match(/version:\s+([0-9.]+)/)
  match ? match[1] : "1.0.0"
end

# ── External TestFlight distribution (issue #239) ─────────────────────────
# A missing repo variable is a LOUD named failure at lane start (AC1) —
# never a fastlane stack trace mid-upload. The variables are set once as
# repo variables and passed through by build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml.
def require_env!(name, what)
  value = ENV[name].to_s.strip
  UI.user_error!("#{name} is not set — #{what}") if value.empty?
  value
end

def external_testflight_group!
  require_env!("TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP",
               "external TestFlight distribution needs the group name (create the 'External Beta' group in App Store Connect, then set the TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP repo variable)")
end

# Beta App Review contact (AC2): external distribution only flips green
# unattended when the review info is complete. The app is local-first —
# it boots without any account or key, so no demo account is required.
def beta_app_review_info!
  {
    contact_first_name: ENV.fetch("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_FIRST_NAME", "Uladzimir"),
    contact_last_name: ENV.fetch("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_LAST_NAME", "Klyshevich"),
    contact_email: require_env!("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL", "Beta App Review needs a contact email (set the BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL repo variable)"),
    contact_phone: require_env!("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE", "Beta App Review needs a contact phone (set the BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE repo variable)"),
    demo_account_required: false,
    notes: "Local-first AI agent app. No account, sign-in or API key is required — the app boots fully on-device with local models, so there is nothing to sign into."
  }
end

def beta_app_feedback_email!
  require_env!("BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL", "external TestFlight testing needs a feedback email (set the BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL repo variable)")
end

# distribute_external requires a "What to Test" changelog — pilot raises in
# non-interactive CI without one. Reuse the store release notes.
def testflight_changelog
  notes = store_latest_changelog("en")
  notes.empty? ? "Bug fixes and improvements." : notes
end

# Bounded wait for ASC processing (E1): external distribution needs a
# PROCESSED build — pilot silently SKIPS distribution when the wait is
# skipped. Default 90 min; override with TESTFLIGHT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
def testflight_wait_timeout
  seconds = ENV["TESTFLIGHT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"].to_i
  seconds.positive? ? seconds : 5400
end

def asc_token!
  require "spaceship"
  Spaceship::ConnectAPI.token ||= Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Token.create(
    key_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID"],
    issuer_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID"],
    key: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT"]
  )
end

def asc_app!(bundle_id:)
  require "spaceship"
  app = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::App.find(bundle_id)
  UI.user_error!("App #{bundle_id} not found in App Store Connect") if app.nil?
  app
end

# E3: pilot resolves groups BY NAME and silently skips adding the build when
# the name resolves to nothing — fail loudly instead, pointing at the
# variable. Returns [app, matched_group].
def find_external_testflight_group!(bundle_id:, group:)
  asc_token!
  app = asc_app!(bundle_id: bundle_id)
  found = app.get_beta_groups(includes: nil, limit: 200).select { |g| g.name == group }
  UI.user_error!("TestFlight external group '#{group}' (TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP) not found in App Store Connect — create it or fix the repo variable. Nothing was uploaded.") if found.empty?
  [app, found.first]
end

# (release-appstore.yml, issue #239 AC3). Deliberately dependency-free — no

blocks.text:
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Pure pre-flight decision logic for the manual App Store review submission
# (release-appstore.yml, issue #239 AC3). Deliberately dependency-free — no
# fastlane/spaceship requires: the Fastfile lane fetches the ASC facts, this
# module decides, so the whole matrix is testable with plain ruby
# (test/appstore_preflight_test.rb — no gems needed).
module AppstorePreflight
  # App Store version states where the version is already in review, or
  # approved and pending/released: a re-run must be a green no-op, never a
  # duplicate submission (AC3 idempotency, E2). Rejected states are NOT
  # listed — a rejected version may legitimately be resubmitted.
  SUBMITTED_STATES = %w[
    WAITING_FOR_REVIEW
    IN_REVIEW
    PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE
    READY_FOR_SALE
    ACCEPTED
  ].freeze

  # Fat-finger guard: the workflow's `confirm` input must repeat `version`
  # exactly (AC3). Returns the fail decision with a named reason — the lane
  # surfaces it via UI.user_error!, no stack trace, nothing mutated.
  def self.confirm_mismatch?(version:, confirm:)
    confirm != version
  end

  # facts:
  #   version           String, e.g. "1.2.3"
  #   confirm           Workflow `confirm` input — must repeat `version` exactly
  #   app_store_version nil, or { "state" => AppStoreState string }
  #   builds            Array of { "number" => build number string,
  #                               "state"  => "PROCESSING"|"VALID"|"FAILED"|"INVALID" }
  # Returns a decision Hash:
  #   { "action" => "fail",   "reason" => why, "build_number" => nil } — fail BEFORE any mutation
  #   { "action" => "noop",   "reason" => why, "build_number" => nil } — green no-op notice
  #   { "action" => "submit", "reason" => why, "build_number" => n }   — latest processed build
  def self.decide(version:, confirm:, app_store_version:, builds:)
    if confirm_mismatch?(version: version, confirm: confirm)
      return fail_decision("CONFIRM MISMATCH: confirm (#{confirm.inspect}) does not equal version (#{version.inspect}) — aborting before any mutation")
    end
    if app_store_version.nil?
      return fail_decision("App Store version #{version} does not exist yet — run store-metadata.yml (metadata_only) first so the version exists. Nothing was mutated.")
    end
    if builds.empty?
      return fail_decision("No TestFlight build exists for version #{version} — dispatch build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml first. Nothing was mutated.")
    end

    ready = builds.select { |b| b["state"] == "VALID" }
    if ready.empty?
      states = builds.map { |b| b["state"] }.tally.map { |s, n| "#{n} #{s}" }.join(", ")
      return fail_decision("Build(s) for version #{version} are still processing (#{states}) — Apple usually needs 5-30 min; re-run in ~15 minutes. Nothing was mutated.")
    end
    if SUBMITTED_STATES.include?(app_store_version["state"])
      return noop("Version #{version} is already submitted (App Store state #{app_store_version['state']}) — green no-op, nothing re-submitted")
    end

    build_number = ready.map { |b| b["number"].to_i }.max.to_s
    submit("Submitting #{version} (build #{build_number}, latest processed) for App Store review", build_number)
  end

  def self.fail_decision(reason)
    { "action" => "fail", "reason" => reason, "build_number" => nil }
  end

  def self.noop(reason)
    { "action" => "noop", "reason" => reason, "build_number" => nil }
  end

  def self.submit(reason, build_number)
    { "action" => "submit", "reason" => reason, "build_number" => build_number }
  end
end

content.text:
name: Store Metadata & Screenshots

# Uploads store metadata and screenshots for the Fa app (no binary):
# the fastlane `app_store` lanes assemble the committed store goldens
# (flutter_app/test/goldens/store/) and the metadata
# (flutter_app/fastlane/metadata/ + store_artefacts/metadata/ changelogs)
# and push them to App Store Connect via deliver.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ios_content:
        description: 'iOS: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip iOS entirely
          - all              # metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only
      macos_content:
        description: 'macOS: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip macOS entirely
          - all              # metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only
      android_content:
        description: 'Android (Google Play): what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none            # skip Android entirely
          - all             # texts + icon/featureGraphic/screenshots
          - metadata_only   # listing texts only
          - images_only     # icon, feature graphic and screenshots only

permissions:
  contents: read

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177) — a workflow_dispatch
# run (daily-publish leg) gets its OWN group: a push landing mid-run
# cancels the leg as "higher priority waiting request exists" (issue #423).
concurrency:
  group: Store Metadata & Screenshots-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && format('dispatch-{0}', github.run_id) || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ios:
    name: iOS App Store metadata & screenshots
    runs-on: macos-latest
    if: github.event.inputs.ios_content != 'none' && github.event.inputs.ios_content != ''
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      - name: Deploy iOS App Store content
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          IOS_BUNDLE_ID: dev.fa1.app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${{ github.event.inputs.ios_content }}" in
            metadata_only)
              export IOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" IOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="false" ;;
            screenshots_only)
              export IOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="false" IOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="true" ;;
            *)
              export IOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" IOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="true" ;;
          esac
          bundle exec fastlane ios app_store

  macos:
    name: macOS App Store metadata & screenshots
    runs-on: macos-latest
    if: github.event.inputs.macos_content != 'none' && github.event.inputs.macos_content != ''
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      - name: Deploy macOS App Store content
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          MACOS_BUNDLE_ID: dev.fa1.app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${{ github.event.inputs.macos_content }}" in
            metadata_only)
              export MACOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" MACOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="false" ;;
            screenshots_only)
              export MACOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="false" MACOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="true" ;;
            *)
              export MACOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" MACOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="true" ;;
          esac
          bundle exec fastlane mac app_store

  android:
    name: Google Play store listing (texts + images)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' && github.event.inputs.android_content != ''
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      - name: Deploy Google Play store listing
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          # Listing edits are app-level; the track only anchors supply's
          # track resolution — internal exists from the first upload.
          PLAY_TRACK: internal
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${{ github.event.inputs.android_content }}" in
            metadata_only)
              export PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES="false" ;;
            images_only)
              export PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA="false" PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES="true" ;;
            *)
              export PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES="true" ;;
          esac
          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

# Manual App Store review submission (issue #239 Track 2): submits the iOS
# and/or macOS build of an already-processed TestFlight version straight to
# App Store review. Nothing here builds or uploads a binary — the
# `submit_for_review` lanes pre-flight against App Store Connect and fail
# BEFORE any mutation:
#   - the version must exist (create it via store-metadata.yml first)
#   - a processed TestFlight build must exist for the version
#   - a version already in review = green no-op notice (idempotent re-run)
# `confirm` must repeat `version` exactly (fat-finger guard on an
# irreversible-ish action).
#
# Release-after-approval stays a manual ASC click (owner decision for the
# first month): flipping to automatic release is a one-line repo variable,
# APP_STORE_AUTOMATIC_RELEASE=true (E5).
#
# Secrets: only the existing APP_STORE_CONNECT_* — no new credentials.

name: App Store review submission

run-name: "App Store review (${{ inputs.platforms }}): ${{ inputs.version }}"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'App version to submit (must match a processed TestFlight build, e.g. 1.2.3)'
        required: true
        type: string
      platforms:
        description: 'Platforms to submit'
        required: true
        default: both
        type: choice
        options:
          - ios
          - macos
          - both
      confirm:
        description: 'Type the version string again to confirm'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  guard:
    name: Fat-finger guard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Confirm must repeat the version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ inputs.confirm }}" != "${{ inputs.version }}" ]; then
            echo "::error::confirm ('${{ inputs.confirm }}') does not equal version ('${{ inputs.version }}') — aborting before any mutation"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Confirmed: submitting version ${{ inputs.version }} (${{ inputs.platforms }}) for App Store review"

  ios:
    name: Submit iOS for App Store review
    needs: guard
    if: inputs.platforms == 'ios' || inputs.platforms == 'both'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true
          working-directory: flutter_app

      - name: Submit for review (pre-flight fails before any mutation)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          APP_STORE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
