blocks.text:
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Pure pre-flight decision logic for the manual App Store review submission
# (release-appstore.yml, issue #239 AC3). Deliberately dependency-free — no
# fastlane/spaceship requires: the Fastfile lane fetches the ASC facts, this
# module decides, so the whole matrix is testable with plain ruby
# (test/appstore_preflight_test.rb — no gems needed).
module AppstorePreflight
  # App Store version states where the version is already in review, or
  # approved and pending/released: a re-run must be a green no-op, never a
  # duplicate submission (AC3 idempotency, E2). Rejected states are NOT
  # listed — a rejected version may legitimately be resubmitted.
  SUBMITTED_STATES = %w[
    WAITING_FOR_REVIEW
    IN_REVIEW
    PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE
    READY_FOR_SALE
    ACCEPTED
  ].freeze

  # Fat-finger guard: the workflow's `confirm` input must repeat `version`
  # exactly (AC3). Returns the fail decision with a named reason — the lane
  # surfaces it via UI.user_error!, no stack trace, nothing mutated.
  def self.confirm_mismatch?(version:, confirm:)
    confirm != version
  end

  # facts:
  #   version           String, e.g. "1.2.3"
  #   confirm           Workflow `confirm` input — must repeat `version` exactly
  #   app_store_version nil, or { "state" => AppStoreState string }
  #   builds            Array of { "number" => build number string,
  #                               "state"  => "PROCESSING"|"VALID"|"FAILED"|"INVALID" }
  # Returns a decision Hash:
  #   { "action" => "fail",   "reason" => why, "build_number" => nil } — fail BEFORE any mutation
  #   { "action" => "noop",   "reason" => why, "build_number" => nil } — green no-op notice
  #   { "action" => "submit", "reason" => why, "build_number" => n }   — latest processed build
  def self.decide(version:, confirm:, app_store_version:, builds:)
    if confirm_mismatch?(version: version, confirm: confirm)
      return fail_decision("CONFIRM MISMATCH: confirm (#{confirm.inspect}) does not equal version (#{version.inspect}) — aborting before any mutation")
    end
    if app_store_version.nil?
      return fail_decision("App Store version #{version} does not exist yet — run store-metadata.yml (metadata_only) first so the version exists. Nothing was mutated.")
    end
    if builds.empty?
      return fail_decision("No TestFlight build exists for version #{version} — dispatch build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml first. Nothing was mutated.")
    end

    ready = builds.select { |b| b["state"] == "VALID" }
    if ready.empty?
      states = builds.map { |b| b["state"] }.tally.map { |s, n| "#{n} #{s}" }.join(", ")
      return fail_decision("Build(s) for version #{version} are still processing (#{states}) — Apple usually needs 5-30 min; re-run in ~15 minutes. Nothing was mutated.")
    end
    if SUBMITTED_STATES.include?(app_store_version["state"])
      return noop("Version #{version} is already submitted (App Store state #{app_store_version['state']}) — green no-op, nothing re-submitted")
    end

    build_number = ready.map { |b| b["number"].to_i }.max.to_s
    submit("Submitting #{version} (build #{build_number}, latest processed) for App Store review", build_number)
  end

  def self.fail_decision(reason)
    { "action" => "fail", "reason" => reason, "build_number" => nil }
  end

  def self.noop(reason)
    { "action" => "noop", "reason" => reason, "build_number" => nil }
  end

  def self.submit(reason, build_number)
    { "action" => "submit", "reason" => reason, "build_number" => build_number }
  end
end

blocks.text:
name: Store Metadata & Screenshots

# Uploads store metadata and screenshots for the Fa app (no binary):
# the fastlane `app_store` lanes assemble the committed store goldens
# (flutter_app/test/goldens/store/) and the metadata
# (flutter_app/fastlane/metadata/ + store_artefacts/metadata/ changelogs)
# and push them to App Store Connect via deliver.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ios_content:
        description: 'iOS: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip iOS entirely
          - all              # metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only
      macos_content:
        description: 'macOS: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip macOS entirely
          - all              # metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only
      android_content:
        description: 'Android (Google Play): what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none            # skip Android entirely
          - all             # texts + icon/featureGraphic/screenshots
          - metadata_only   # listing texts only
          - images_only     # icon, feature graphic and screenshots only

permissions:
  contents: read

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177) — a workflow_dispatch
# run (daily-publish leg) gets its OWN group: a push landing mid-run
# cancels the leg as "higher priority waiting request exists" (issue #423).
concurrency:
  group: Store Metadata & Screenshots-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && format('dispatch-{0}', github.run_id) || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ios:
    name: iOS App Store metadata & screenshots
    runs-on: macos-latest
    if: github.event.inputs.ios_content != 'none' && github.event.inputs.ios_content != ''
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      - name: Deploy iOS App Store content
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          IOS_BUNDLE_ID: dev.fa1.app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${{ github.event.inputs.ios_content }}" in
            metadata_only)
              export IOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" IOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="false" ;;
            screenshots_only)
              export IOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="false" IOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="true" ;;
            *)
              export IOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" IOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="true" ;;
          esac
          bundle exec fastlane ios app_store

  macos:
    name: macOS App Store metadata & screenshots
    runs-on: macos-latest
    if: github.event.inputs.macos_content != 'none' && github.event.inputs.macos_content != ''
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      - name: Deploy macOS App Store content
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          MACOS_BUNDLE_ID: dev.fa1.app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${{ github.event.inputs.macos_content }}" in
            metadata_only)
              export MACOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" MACOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="false" ;;
            screenshots_only)
              export MACOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="false" MACOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="true" ;;
            *)
              export MACOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" MACOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="true" ;;
          esac
          bundle exec fastlane mac app_store

  android:
    name: Google Play store listing (texts + images)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' && github.event.inputs.android_content != ''
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      - name: Deploy Google Play store listing
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          # Listing edits are app-level; the track only anchors supply's
          # track resolution — internal exists from the first upload.
          PLAY_TRACK: internal
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${{ github.event.inputs.android_content }}" in
            metadata_only)
              export PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES="false" ;;
            images_only)
              export PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA="false" PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES="true" ;;
            *)
              export PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES="true" ;;
          esac
          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

# Manual App Store review submission (issue #239 Track 2): submits the iOS
# and/or macOS build of an already-processed TestFlight version straight to

blocks.text:
# Manual App Store review submission (issue #239 Track 2): submits the iOS
# and/or macOS build of an already-processed TestFlight version straight to
# App Store review. Nothing here builds or uploads a binary — the
# `submit_for_review` lanes pre-flight against App Store Connect and fail
# BEFORE any mutation:
#   - the version must exist (create it via store-metadata.yml first)
#   - a processed TestFlight build must exist for the version
#   - a version already in review = green no-op notice (idempotent re-run)
# `confirm` must repeat `version` exactly (fat-finger guard on an
# irreversible-ish action).
#
# Release-after-approval stays a manual ASC click (owner decision for the
# first month): flipping to automatic release is a one-line repo variable,
# APP_STORE_AUTOMATIC_RELEASE=true (E5).
#
# Secrets: only the existing APP_STORE_CONNECT_* — no new credentials.

name: App Store review submission

run-name: "App Store review (${{ inputs.platforms }}): ${{ inputs.version }}"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'App version to submit (must match a processed TestFlight build, e.g. 1.2.3)'
        required: true
        type: string
      platforms:
        description: 'Platforms to submit'
        required: true
        default: both
        type: choice
        options:
          - ios
          - macos
          - both
      confirm:
        description: 'Type the version string again to confirm'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  guard:
    name: Fat-finger guard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Confirm must repeat the version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ inputs.confirm }}" != "${{ inputs.version }}" ]; then
            echo "::error::confirm ('${{ inputs.confirm }}') does not equal version ('${{ inputs.version }}') — aborting before any mutation"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Confirmed: submitting version ${{ inputs.version }} (${{ inputs.platforms }}) for App Store review"

  ios:
    name: Submit iOS for App Store review
    needs: guard
    if: inputs.platforms == 'ios' || inputs.platforms == 'both'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true
          working-directory: flutter_app

      - name: Submit for review (pre-flight fails before any mutation)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          APP_STORE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          APP_STORE_CONFIRM: ${{ inputs.confirm }}
        run: bundle exec fastlane ios submit_for_review

  macos:
    name: Submit macOS for App Store review
    needs: guard
    if: inputs.platforms == 'macos' || inputs.platforms == 'both'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true
          working-directory: flutter_app

      - name: Submit for review (pre-flight fails before any mutation)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          APP_STORE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          APP_STORE_CONFIRM: ${{ inputs.confirm }}
        run: bundle exec fastlane mac submit_for_review

# Issue #239 AC3 — release-appstore.yml pre-flight matrix. Plain ruby, no
# gems (runs on the CI runner's stock ruby and anywhere else):
#
#   ruby flutter_app/fastlane/test/appstore_preflight_test.rb
#
# Guarded by $PROGRAM_NAME so an accidental require by fastlane's loader
# never executes the checks.

require_relative "../appstore_preflight"

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  $checks = 0

  def ok(message)
    $checks += 1
    puts "  ok: #{message}"
  end

  # AC3 — confirm mismatch → fail decision with a named reason (the lane
  # surfaces it via UI.user_error!); nothing mutated either way.
  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(version: "1.2.3", confirm: "1.2.4", app_store_version: nil, builds: [])
  raise "FAIL: confirm mismatch must fail first, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "fail" && d["reason"].include?("CONFIRM MISMATCH") && d["reason"].include?("1.2.4")
  ok("confirm mismatch → named fail decision, nothing mutated")
  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(version: "1.2.3", confirm: "1.2.3", app_store_version: nil, builds: [])
  raise "FAIL: matching confirm must fall through to version check, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "fail" && d["reason"].include?("store-metadata.yml")

  # AC3 — version missing from ASC → fail before mutation
  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(version: "9.9.9", confirm: "9.9.9", app_store_version: nil, builds: [])
  raise "FAIL: version missing must fail, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "fail" && d["reason"].include?("9.9.9") && d["reason"].include?("store-metadata.yml")
  ok("version missing → fail before mutation, points at store-metadata.yml")

  # AC3 — build still processing → fail with an ETA hint
  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(
    version: "1.2.3",
    confirm: "1.2.3",
    app_store_version: { "state" => "PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION" },
    builds: [{ "number" => "7", "state" => "PROCESSING" }]
  )
  raise "FAIL: processing must fail with ETA hint, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "fail" && d["reason"].include?("still processing") && d["reason"].include?("~15 minutes")
  ok("build still processing → fail with ETA hint, nothing submitted")

  # AC3 — already submitted → green no-op (idempotent re-run, E2)
  %w[WAITING_FOR_REVIEW IN_REVIEW PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE READY_FOR_SALE ACCEPTED].each do |state|

      version: "1.2.3",
      confirm: "1.2.3",

  end

    version: "1.2.3",
    confirm: "1.2.3",
    app_store_version: { "state" => "PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION" },
    builds: [

      { "number" => "9", "state" => "PROCESSING" },
      { "number" => "7", "state" => "VALID" }
    ]
  )
  raise "FAIL: must submit build 7, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "submit" && d["build_number"] == "7"
  ok("submit targets the latest PROCESSED build (7), skipping still-processing 9")

  # No builds at all → fail before mutation
  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(version: "1.2.3", confirm: "1.2.3", app_store_version: { "state" => "PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION" }, builds: [])
  raise "FAIL: no builds must fail, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "fail" && d["reason"].include?("No TestFlight build")
  ok("no builds for the version → fail before mutation")

  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(
    version: "1.2.3",
    confirm: "1.2.3",
    app_store_version: { "state" => "REJECTED" },
    builds: [{ "number" => "7", "state" => "VALID" }]
  )
  raise "FAIL: REJECTED must be submittable, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "submit"
  ok("REJECTED state stays resubmittable")

  puts "appstore_preflight: #{$checks} checks OK"
end

Design plan:

**1. New pure module `store_version_create.rb`** (decision logic for creation + idempotency):
```ruby
module StoreVersionCreate
  # gh-1519: deliver with skip_app_version_update never materializes the
  # version record, so the release-appstore pre-flight dead-ends. Decide
  # whether an explicit ASC appStoreVersions POST is needed BEFORE deliver.
  def self.missing?(versions:, version:)
    !versions.map { |v| v.to_s }.include?(version.to_s)
  end
end
```

Hmm, that might be too trivial to warrant a module. Alternative: put a helper `ensure_app_store_version!` in the Fastfile (not unit-testable in plain ruby since it needs spaceship). The testable decision is "version missing among fetched versions". I'll create the module with the decision + maybe a function that returns the create attributes for the POST. Let me make it a bit more substantive:

```ruby
module StoreVersionCreate
  # gh-1519 — store-metadata must CREATE the App Store version when absent.
  # deliver's skip_app_version_update:true never materializes the record,
  # so release-appstore.yml's pre-flight dead-ended on every fresh version.
  # Returns true when an explicit appStoreVersions POST is required.
  def self.needs_create?(existing:, version:)
    !existing.map(&:to_s).include?(version.to_s)
  end

  # Attributes for the POST /v1/appStoreVersions call (Spaceship
  # create_app_store_version). Pure data — the Fastfile performs the POST.
  def self.create_attributes(platform:, version:)
    { platform: platform, versionString: version }
  end
end
```

**2. Fastfile changes:**

- Add helper:
```ruby
# gh-1519: store-metadata's app_store lanes must CREATE the App Store
# version when absent (deliver with skip_app_version_update never does),
# otherwise release-appstore.yml's pre-flight dead-ends on every fresh
# version. Idempotent: only POSTs when the version is missing.
def ensure_app_store_version!(bundle_id:, platform:, version:)
  asc_token!
  app = asc_app!(bundle_id: bundle_id)
  existing = with_apple_retries(attempts: 3, delay: 20) do
    app.get_app_store_versions(filter: { platform: platform }).map(&:version_string)
  end
  return app if !StoreVersionCreate.needs_create?(existing: existing, version: version)
  UI.message("App Store version #{version} (#{platform}) does not exist yet — creating it via the appStoreVersions API before deliver (gh-1519)")
  app.create_app_store_version(attributes: StoreVersionCreate.create_attributes(platform: platform, version: version))
  UI.success("Created App Store version #{version} (#{platform})")
  app
rescue => e
  UI.user_error!("Could not create App Store version #{version} (#{platform}): #{e.message}")
end
```

Wait — platform for the filter is `Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Platform::IOS` ("IOS") and for mac "MAC_OS". For create_app_store_version attributes, platform should be the same string. Good.

Where to call: in iOS `app_store` lane after `version_name = store_pubspec_version`, before the metadata step. Should it be gated on do_metadata? The deliver calls happen for metadata and/or screenshots. For a screenshots-only run on an absent version, deliver would fail anyway; creating is harmless and helps. But create might be undesirable when only screenshots for an existing version... needs_create? returns false then. I'll call it unconditionally (both do_metadata or do_screenshots imply a deliver). Hmm — but what if both are false? Then the lane does nothing but still creates a version. Edge case; IOS_DEPLOY_METADATA=false + IOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS=false means "skip iOS entirely" — the workflow uses ios_content=none for that, but env vars could both be false. Guard: `if do_metadata || do_screenshots`. Actually simpler and matching the ticket ("metadata lanes must CREATE the version"): call it when do_metadata. But screenshots-only fresh-version would break. I'll guard on either.

Also `with_apple_retries` yields and returns block value — check: the current `with_apple_retries` implementation: `yield` as last statement of begin → returns block result. Yes, `begin ... yield ... rescue ... end` returns yield's value. Good.

- Drop `skip_app_version_update: true` from the four deliver calls in the two app_store lanes? Requirement says "drop skip_app_version_update: true (or add an explicit ASC appStoreVersions POST via Spaceship before deliver)". We add the POST. Keeping the flag avoids deliver's own version-update path (which had "cannot create a new version" errors on mac). Hmm — but with the flag kept, deliver with app_version + existing version uploads metadata to that version — exactly what the lane does today. That's fine and minimal.

But wait: the ticket's acceptance says "drop `skip_app_version_update: true` (or add an explicit POST...)". Either is acceptable. I'll go with the explicit POST (deterministic, idempotent, testable) and KEEP the flag to avoid deliver's flaky version-update path. Hmm, but should I also drop the flag to fully honor "drop"? The current flag's semantic: skip updating version selection. With the version created explicitly, deliver still needs to target it — it does via app_version param regardless of the flag. I'll keep the flag and note in response.md why (deliver's own create path is the one that produced "cannot create a new version" 500s on mac; explicit POST is deterministic).

Hmm, actually wait. Let me reconsider: does deliver with `skip_app_version_update: true` and `app_version: version_name` work when the version EXISTS? Yes — that's the current idempotent path for existing versions (metadata update only). Good, REG acceptance preserved.

- macOS lane: also has the preflight block that bails when no editable mac version exists ("No editable macOS App Store version... Create the macOS X version in App Store Connect..."). With ensure-create before that preflight, the preflight will find the version. Order: compute version_name, ensure create, then the existing preflight probe. 

- iOS lane currently has NO preflight — just deliver. Add ensure-create call.

**3. Pre-flight remediation message fix** in appstore_preflight.rb:
Current: "App Store version #{version} does not exist yet — run store-metadata.yml (metadata_only) first so the version exists. Nothing was mutated."
New: name the creating step explicitly: "App Store version #{version} does not exist yet — run store-metadata.yml (metadata_only) first: its app_store lane creates the version when absent (gh-1519). Nothing was mutated."

Tests check `d["reason"].include?("store-metadata.yml")` — still satisfied.

**4. Bounded retry in pre-flight read-side** (`appstore_submission_decision` in Fastfile): after creation, `get_app_store_versions` may lag. Add bounded retry: e.g. 3 attempts with 20s sleep, only retrying while version absent... but the decision function handles nil version as fail. Implement in the helper:

```ruby
def appstore_submission_decision(bundle_id:, platform:, version:, confirm:)
  app = asc_app!(bundle_id: bundle_id)
  # gh-1519 read-side: a freshly created version can trail in ASC reads —
  # bounded retry instead of an instant fail.
  app_store_version = nil
  3.times do |attempt|
    app_store_version = app
                        .get_app_store_versions(filter: { platform: platform })
                        .find { |v| v.version_string == version }
    break if app_store_version
    UI.important("App Store version #{version} not visible yet (attempt #{attempt + 1}/3) — ASC read lag, retrying in 20s...") if attempt < 2
    sleep(20) if attempt < 2
  end
  ...
end
```

Hmm, but this changes behavior: previously instant fail; now up to ~40s wait when version genuinely absent. That's what the ticket asks ("add a bounded retry to the pre-flight rather than an instant fail"). Note existing mac lane preflight does 2 attempts with 20s sleep — consistent pattern.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-1519 — Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The store pipeline has no step that creates a new App Store version, so every fresh release dead-ends: store-metadata runs green but creates nothing, and release-appstore's pre-flight refuses to submit (v1.0.548 needed manual ASC UI intervention).

**Root cause**: `flutter_app/fastlane/Fastfile` — the `app_store` lanes (iOS line ~554, macOS line ~748) call `deliver(..., app_version: store_pubspec_version, skip_app_version_update: true, ...)`. The `skip_app_version_update: true` flag tells deliver to never create/update the App Store version record, so for an absent version deliver logs "Uploading metadata … for version" with an EMPTY version string and exits green without materializing anything. Meanwhile the release-appstore pre-flight (`appstore_submission_decision`, Fastfile:186 → `AppstorePreflight.decide`, appstore_preflight.rb) correctly fails with "App Store version X does not exist yet — run store-metadata.yml (metadata_only) first" — a remediation store-metadata cannot satisfy.

**Impact**: Any release with a version string not yet present in App Store Connect: store-metadata.yml (both legs green) → release-appstore.yml fails 4× → owner manually creates the version in the ASC UI and submits by hand. REG risk on re-run: none today (deliver is idempotent on existing versions).

**Fix approach**:
1. **Create the version when absent (gh-1519 req 1)**: before deliver, the `app_store` lanes explicitly POST an `appStoreVersions` record via Spaceship (`app.create_app_store_version`) when `get_app_store_versions` does not contain `store_pubspec_version` — for both iOS and macOS lanes. The create/no-create decision lives in a new pure-ruby module `store_version_create.rb` (testable without fastlane, the established version_floor.rb/play_upload_preflight.rb pattern). Idempotent: existing version → no POST, deliver proceeds exactly as today (REG acceptance). The explicit POST is chosen over dropping `skip_app_version_update` because deliver's own version-create path is the one that produced Apple's opaque "cannot create a new version" 500s on macOS (already special-cased in the lane's rescue); a deterministic pre-deliver POST avoids that class entirely.
2. **Fix the pre-flight remediation text (req 2)**: `AppstorePreflight.decide`'s missing-version reason now names the creating step ("its app_store lane creates the version when absent (gh-1519)") instead of implying store-metadata already does it. The pre-flight decision logic itself is unchanged — it caught the hole correctly.
3. **Bounded read-side retry (req 3)**: `appstore_submission_decision` retries the `get_app_store_versions(filter: { platform: })` lookup up to 3 attempts / 20s apart when the version is not yet visible, absorbing ASC read lag after a fresh creation instead of failing instantly (same pattern as the macOS lane's existing 2-attempt preflight probe).

**Previous attempt**: none — fresh bug (not returned from QA/test automation).
"}

# gh-1519: [BUG] Store pipeline cannot create an App Store version: store-metadata runs deliver with skip_app_version_update=true, release-appstore pre-flight dead-ends (v1.0.548 needed manual ASC)

## Description

## Symptom (release v1.0.548, 2026-10-10)

Full release required MANUAL owner intervention: `release-appstore.yml` pre-flight failed 4× with "App Store version 1.0.548 does not exist yet — run store-metadata.yml (metadata_only) first. Nothing was mutated." — but running store-metadata.yml (both legs green) did NOT create the version. Owner created the App Store version by hand in the ASC UI and submitted manually.

## Root cause

The pipeline has NO step that creates a new App Store version:

- `store-metadata.yml` → fastlane `app_store` lane runs `deliver(app_version: store_pubspec_version, skip_app_version_update: true, …)` — the `skip_app_version_update: true` flag tells deliver to never create/update the version record (Fastfile.swift-equivalent at flutter_app/fastlane/Fastfile:554). The run log confirms: "Uploading metadata to App Store Connect for version" with an EMPTY version string.
- `release-appstore.yml` pre-flight (`appstore_submission_decision`, Fastfile:186) correctly refuses when the version is absent — but the remediation it prints is wrong: store-metadata cannot satisfy it.

So the documented remediation loop (`run store-metadata first`) is a dead end; every new version needs a manual ASC click.

## Requirement

1. store-metadata's metadata lanes must CREATE the version when absent: drop `skip_app_version_update: true` (or add an explicit ASC `appStoreVersions` POST via Spaceship before deliver) so `app_version` actually materializes the version record. Applies to both iOS and macOS lanes.
2. Keep the release-appstore pre-flight as-is (it caught the hole correctly) but fix its printed remediation to name the creating step.
3. Verify read-side: after creation, `get_app_store_versions(filter: { platform: })` must find the new version — if ASC read lag/pagination hides freshly created versions, add a bounded retry to the pre-flight rather than an instant fail.

## Acceptance

- Fresh version end-to-end unattended: build-mobile (TF) → store-metadata → release-appstore submits for review with zero manual ASC clicks (release-after-approval stays manual per E5).
- REG: re-running store-metadata on an EXISTING version stays idempotent (metadata update only, no duplicate version error).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

# Fastfile for the Fa app (flutter_app).
#
# TestFlight submit lanes, adapted 1:1 from learn.ai's deploy setup: builds
# happen in the CI workflows (flutter build ipa / flutter build macos), so
# these lanes only upload the produced artifacts with the App Store Connect
# API key from the environment:
#
# The daily's submit_only lanes distribute straight to the EXTERNAL
# TestFlight group (issue #239): the group name and Beta App Review contact
# ride repo variables (TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP, BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_*,
# BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL). release-appstore.yml drives the manual
# submit_for_review lanes (App Store review submission).
#   APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID / APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID /
#   APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT
#
# Android (#289): the build_only/build_release + upload_only lanes follow
# the same split against Google Play; the service-account JSON rides
# PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON and
# the track rides PLAY_TRACK (internal first, then external beta).
#
# iOS:    IOS_IPA_PATH points at the built .ipa (default: build/ios/*.ipa's
#         conventional location).
# macOS:  MACOS_PKG_PATH points at the signed .pkg (Mac Installer
#         Distribution cert) and MACOS_BUNDLE_ID overrides dev.fa1.app.

require_relative "appstore_preflight"
require_relative "play_listing_sync"
require_relative "play_upload_preflight"
require_relative "version_floor"

def asc_api_key
  app_store_connect_api_key(
    key_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID"],
    issuer_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID"],
    key_content: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT"],
    is_key_content_base64: false,
    in_house: false
  )
end

# App Store locale map for the store pipeline: fastlane/metadata folder →
# App Store Connect locale. Golden screenshots live one level below under
# the plain language code (test/goldens/store/<en|ru>/<ios|ipad|mac>).
def store_locale_map
  { "en-US" => "en-US", "ru-RU" => "ru" }
end

# Latest "## [version]" section of store_artefacts/metadata/<lang>/changelog.md.
def store_latest_changelog(lang)
  file_path = File.expand_path("../../store_artefacts/metadata/#{lang}/changelog.md", __dir__)
  return "" unless File.exist?(file_path)
  content = File.read(file_path)
  match = content.match(/## \[.*?\][^\n]*\n(.*?)(?=\n## \[|\z)/m)
  match ? match[1].strip : ""
end

def store_pubspec_version
  pubspec_path = File.expand_path("../pubspec.yaml", __dir__)
  return "1.0.0" unless File.exist?(pubspec_path)
  match = File.read(pubspec_path).match(/version:\s+([0-9.]+)/)
  match ? match[1] : "1.0.0"
end

# ── External TestFlight distribution (issue #239) ─────────────────────────
# A missing repo variable is a LOUD named failure at lane start (AC1) —
# never a fastlane stack trace mid-upload. The variables are set once as
# repo variables and passed through by build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml.
def require_env!(name, what)
  value = ENV[name].to_s.strip
  UI.user_error!("#{name} is not set — #{what}") if value.empty?
  value
end

def external_testflight_group!
  require_env!("TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP",
               "external TestFlight distribution needs the group name (create the 'External Beta' group in App Store Connect, then set the TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP repo variable)")
end

# Beta App Review contact (AC2): external distribution only flips green
# unattended when the review info is complete. The app is local-first —
# it boots without any account or key, so no demo account is required.
def beta_app_review_info!
  {
    contact_first_name: ENV.fetch("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_FIRST_NAME", "Uladzimir"),
    contact_last_name: ENV.fetch("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_LAST_NAME", "Klyshevich"),
    contact_email: require_env!("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL", "Beta App Review needs a contact email (set the BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL repo variable)"),
    contact_phone: require_env!("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE", "Beta App Review needs a contact phone (set the BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE repo variable)"),
    demo_account_required: false,

blocks.text:
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Pure pre-flight decision logic for the manual App Store review submission
# (release-appstore.yml, issue #239 AC3). Deliberately dependency-free — no
# fastlane/spaceship requires: the Fastfile lane fetches the ASC facts, this
# module decides, so the whole matrix is testable with plain ruby
# (test/appstore_preflight_test.rb — no gems needed).
module AppstorePreflight
  # App Store version states where the version is already in review, or
  # approved and pending/released: a re-run must be a green no-op, never a
  # duplicate submission (AC3 idempotency, E2). Rejected states are NOT
  # listed — a rejected version may legitimately be resubmitted.
  SUBMITTED_STATES = %w[
    WAITING_FOR_REVIEW
    IN_REVIEW
    PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE
    READY_FOR_SALE
    ACCEPTED
  ].freeze

  # Fat-finger guard: the workflow's `confirm` input must repeat `version`
  # exactly (AC3). Returns the fail decision with a named reason — the lane
  # surfaces it via UI.user_error!, no stack trace, nothing mutated.
  def self.confirm_mismatch?(version:, confirm:)
    confirm != version
  end

  # facts:
  #   version           String, e.g. "1.2.3"
  #   confirm           Workflow `confirm` input — must repeat `version` exactly
  #   app_store_version nil, or { "state" => AppStoreState string }
  #   builds            Array of { "number" => build number string,
  #                               "state"  => "PROCESSING"|"VALID"|"FAILED"|"INVALID" }
  # Returns a decision Hash:
  #   { "action" => "fail",   "reason" => why, "build_number" => nil } — fail BEFORE any mutation
  #   { "action" => "noop",   "reason" => why, "build_number" => nil } — green no-op notice
  #   { "action" => "submit", "reason" => why, "build_number" => n }   — latest processed build
  def self.decide(version:, confirm:, app_store_version:, builds:)
    if confirm_mismatch?(version: version, confirm: confirm)
      return fail_decision("CONFIRM MISMATCH: confirm (#{confirm.inspect}) does not equal version (#{version.inspect}) — aborting before any mutation")
    end
    if app_store_version.nil?
      return fail_decision("App Store version #{version} does not exist yet — run store-metadata.yml (metadata_only) first so the version exists. Nothing was mutated.")
    end
    if builds.empty?
      return fail_decision("No TestFlight build exists for version #{version} — dispatch build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml first. Nothing was mutated.")
    end

    ready = builds.select { |b| b["state"] == "VALID" }
    if ready.empty?
      states = builds.map { |b| b["state"] }.tally.map { |s, n| "#{n} #{s}" }.join(", ")
      return fail_decision("Build(s) for version #{version} are still processing (#{states}) — Apple usually needs 5-30 min; re-run in ~15 minutes. Nothing was mutated.")
    end
    if SUBMITTED_STATES.include?(app_store_version["state"])
      return noop("Version #{version} is already submitted (App Store state #{app_store_version['state']}) — green no-op, nothing re-submitted")
    end

    build_number = ready.map { |b| b["number"].to_i }.max.to_s
    submit("Submitting #{version} (build #{build_number}, latest processed) for App Store review", build_number)
  end

  def self.fail_decision(reason)
    { "action" => "fail", "reason" => reason, "build_number" => nil }
  end

  def self.noop(reason)
    { "action" => "noop", "reason" => reason, "build_number" => nil }
  end

  def self.submit(reason, build_number)
    { "action" => "submit", "reason" => reason, "build_number" => build_number }
  end
end

blocks.text:
name: Store Metadata & Screenshots

# Uploads store metadata and screenshots for the Fa app (no binary):
# the fastlane `app_store` lanes assemble the committed store goldens
# (flutter_app/test/goldens/store/) and the metadata
# (flutter_app/fastlane/metadata/ + store_artefacts/metadata/ changelogs)
# and push them to App Store Connect via deliver.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ios_content:
        description: 'iOS: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip iOS entirely
          - all              # metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only
      macos_content:
        description: 'macOS: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip macOS entirely
          - all              # metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only
      android_content:
        description: 'Android (Google Play): what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none            # skip Android entirely
          - all             # texts + icon/featureGraphic/screenshots
          - metadata_only   # listing texts only
          - images_only     # icon, feature graphic and screenshots only

permissions:
  contents: read

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177) — a workflow_dispatch
# run (daily-publish leg) gets its OWN group: a push landing mid-run
# cancels the leg as "higher priority waiting request exists" (issue #423).
concurrency:
  group: Store Metadata & Screenshots-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && format('dispatch-{0}', github.run_id) || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ios:
    name: iOS App Store metadata & screenshots
    runs-on: macos-latest
    if: github.event.inputs.ios_content != 'none' && github.event.inputs.ios_content != ''
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      - name: Deploy iOS App Store content
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          IOS_BUNDLE_ID: dev.fa1.app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${{ github.event.inputs.ios_content }}" in
            metadata_only)
              export IOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" IOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="false" ;;
            screenshots_only)
              export IOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="false" IOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="true" ;;
            *)
              export IOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" IOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="true" ;;
          esac
          bundle exec fastlane ios app_store

  macos:
    name: macOS App Store metadata & screenshots
    runs-on: macos-latest
    if: github.event.inputs.macos_content != 'none' && github.event.inputs.macos_content != ''
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      - name: Deploy macOS App Store content
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          MACOS_BUNDLE_ID: dev.fa1.app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${{ github.event.inputs.macos_content }}" in
            metadata_only)
              export MACOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" MACOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="false" ;;
            screenshots_only)
              export MACOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="false" MACOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="true" ;;
            *)
              export MACOS_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" MACOS_DEPLOY_SCREENSHOTS="true" ;;
          esac
          bundle exec fastlane mac app_store

  android:
    name: Google Play store listing (texts + images)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' && github.event.inputs.android_content != ''
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      - name: Deploy Google Play store listing
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          # Listing edits are app-level; the track only anchors supply's
          # track resolution — internal exists from the first upload.
          PLAY_TRACK: internal
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${{ github.event.inputs.android_content }}" in
            metadata_only)
              export PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES="false" ;;
            images_only)
              export PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA="false" PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES="true" ;;
            *)
              export PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA="true" PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES="true" ;;
          esac
          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

# Manual App Store review submission (issue #239 Track 2): submits the iOS
# and/or macOS build of an already-processed TestFlight version straight to

blocks.text:
# Manual App Store review submission (issue #239 Track 2): submits the iOS
# and/or macOS build of an already-processed TestFlight version straight to
# App Store review. Nothing here builds or uploads a binary — the
# `submit_for_review` lanes pre-flight against App Store Connect and fail
# BEFORE any mutation:
#   - the version must exist (create it via store-metadata.yml first)
#   - a processed TestFlight build must exist for the version
#   - a version already in review = green no-op notice (idempotent re-run)
# `confirm` must repeat `version` exactly (fat-finger guard on an
# irreversible-ish action).
#
# Release-after-approval stays a manual ASC click (owner decision for the
# first month): flipping to automatic release is a one-line repo variable,
# APP_STORE_AUTOMATIC_RELEASE=true (E5).
#
# Secrets: only the existing APP_STORE_CONNECT_* — no new credentials.

name: App Store review submission

run-name: "App Store review (${{ inputs.platforms }}): ${{ inputs.version }}"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'App version to submit (must match a processed TestFlight build, e.g. 1.2.3)'
        required: true
        type: string
      platforms:
        description: 'Platforms to submit'
        required: true
        default: both
        type: choice
        options:
          - ios
          - macos
          - both
      confirm:
        description: 'Type the version string again to confirm'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  guard:
    name: Fat-finger guard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Confirm must repeat the version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ inputs.confirm }}" != "${{ inputs.version }}" ]; then
            echo "::error::confirm ('${{ inputs.confirm }}') does not equal version ('${{ inputs.version }}') — aborting before any mutation"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Confirmed: submitting version ${{ inputs.version }} (${{ inputs.platforms }}) for App Store review"

  ios:
    name: Submit iOS for App Store review
    needs: guard
    if: inputs.platforms == 'ios' || inputs.platforms == 'both'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true
          working-directory: flutter_app

      - name: Submit for review (pre-flight fails before any mutation)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          APP_STORE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          APP_STORE_CONFIRM: ${{ inputs.confirm }}
        run: bundle exec fastlane ios submit_for_review

  macos:
    name: Submit macOS for App Store review
    needs: guard
    if: inputs.platforms == 'macos' || inputs.platforms == 'both'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true
          working-directory: flutter_app

      - name: Submit for review (pre-flight fails before any mutation)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          APP_STORE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          APP_STORE_CONFIRM: ${{ inputs.confirm }}
        run: bundle exec fastlane mac submit_for_review

# Issue #239 AC3 — release-appstore.yml pre-flight matrix. Plain ruby, no
# gems (runs on the CI runner's stock ruby and anywhere else):
#
#   ruby flutter_app/fastlane/test/appstore_preflight_test.rb
#
# Guarded by $PROGRAM_NAME so an accidental require by fastlane's loader
# never executes the checks.

require_relative "../appstore_preflight"

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  $checks = 0

  def ok(message)
    $checks += 1
    puts "  ok: #{message}"
  end

  # AC3 — confirm mismatch → fail decision with a named reason (the lane
  # surfaces it via UI.user_error!); nothing mutated either way.
  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(version: "1.2.3", confirm: "1.2.4", app_store_version: nil, builds: [])
  raise "FAIL: confirm mismatch must fail first, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "fail" && d["reason"].include?("CONFIRM MISMATCH") && d["reason"].include?("1.2.4")
  ok("confirm mismatch → named fail decision, nothing mutated")
  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(version: "1.2.3", confirm: "1.2.3", app_store_version: nil, builds: [])
  raise "FAIL: matching confirm must fall through to version check, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "fail" && d["reason"].include?("store-metadata.yml")
  ok("matching confirm passes through")

  # AC3 — version missing from ASC → fail before mutation
  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(version: "9.9.9", confirm: "9.9.9", app_store_version: nil, builds: [])
  raise "FAIL: version missing must fail, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "fail" && d["reason"].include?("9.9.9") && d["reason"].include?("store-metadata.yml")
  ok("version missing → fail before mutation, points at store-metadata.yml")

  # AC3 — build still processing → fail with an ETA hint
  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(
    version: "1.2.3",
    confirm: "1.2.3",
    app_store_version: { "state" => "PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION" },
    builds: [{ "number" => "7", "state" => "PROCESSING" }]
  )
  raise "FAIL: processing must fail with ETA hint, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "fail" && d["reason"].include?("still processing") && d["reason"].include?("~15 minutes")
  ok("build still processing → fail with ETA hint, nothing submitted")

  # AC3 — already submitted → green no-op (idempotent re-run, E2)
  %w[WAITING_FOR_REVIEW IN_REVIEW PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE READY_FOR_SALE ACCEPTED].each do |state|
    d = AppstorePreflight.decide(
      version: "1.2.3",
      confirm: "1.2.3",
      app_store_version: { "state" => state },
      builds: [{ "number" => "7", "state" => "VALID" }]
    )
    raise "FAIL: #{state} must be a noop, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "noop" && d["reason"].include?(state)
  end
  ok("in-flight/submitted states → green no-op notice")

  # Happy path — the latest PROCESSED build wins; processing builds are ignored
  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(
    version: "1.2.3",
    confirm: "1.2.3",
    app_store_version: { "state" => "PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION" },
    builds: [
      { "number" => "5", "state" => "VALID" },
      { "number" => "9", "state" => "PROCESSING" },
      { "number" => "7", "state" => "VALID" }
    ]
  )
  raise "FAIL: must submit build 7, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "submit" && d["build_number"] == "7"
  ok("submit targets the latest PROCESSED build (7), skipping still-processing 9")

  # No builds at all → fail before mutation
  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(version: "1.2.3", confirm: "1.2.3", app_store_version: { "state" => "PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION" }, builds: [])
  raise "FAIL: no builds must fail, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "fail" && d["reason"].include?("No TestFlight build")
  ok("no builds for the version → fail before mutation")

  # Rejected versions stay resubmittable (NOT in SUBMITTED_STATES)
  d = AppstorePreflight.decide(
    version: "1.2.3",
    confirm: "1.2.3",
    app_store_version: { "state" => "REJECTED" },
    builds: [{ "number" => "7", "state" => "VALID" }]
  )
  raise "FAIL: REJECTED must be submittable, got #{d.inspect}" unless d["action"] == "submit"
  ok("REJECTED state stays resubmittable")

  puts "appstore_preflight: #{$checks} checks OK"
end

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-1519 — Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The store pipeline has no step that creates a new App Store version, so every fresh release dead-ends: store-metadata runs green but creates nothing, and release-appstore's pre-flight refuses to submit (v1.0.548 needed manual ASC UI intervention).

**Root cause**: `flutter_app/fastlane/Fastfile` — the `app_store` lanes (iOS line ~554, macOS line ~748) call `deliver(..., app_version: store_pubspec_version, skip_app_version_update: true, ...)`. The `skip_app_version_update: true` flag tells deliver to never create/update the App Store version record, so for an absent version deliver logs "Uploading metadata … for version" with an EMPTY version string and exits green without materializing anything. Meanwhile the release-appstore pre-flight (`appstore_submission_decision`, Fastfile:186 → `AppstorePreflight.decide`, appstore_preflight.rb) correctly fails with "App Store version X does not exist yet — run store-metadata.yml (metadata_only) first" — a remediation store-metadata cannot satisfy.

**Impact**: Any release with a version string not yet present in App Store Connect: store-metadata.yml (both legs green) → release-appstore.yml fails 4× → owner manually creates the version in the ASC UI and submits by hand. REG risk on re-run: none today (deliver is idempotent on existing versions).

**Fix approach**:
1. **Create the version when absent (gh-1519 req 1)**: before deliver, the `app_store` lanes explicitly POST an `appStoreVersions` record via Spaceship (`app.create_app_store_version`) when `get_app_store_versions` does not contain `store_pubspec_version` — for both iOS and macOS lanes. The create/no-create decision lives in a new pure-ruby module `store_version_create.rb` (testable without fastlane, the established version_floor.rb/play_upload_preflight.rb pattern). Idempotent: existing version → no POST, deliver proceeds exactly as today (REG acceptance). The explicit POST is chosen over dropping `skip_app_version_update` because deliver's own version-create path is the one that produced Apple's opaque "cannot create a new version" 500s on macOS (already special-cased in the lane's rescue); a deterministic pre-deliver POST avoids that class entirely.
2. **Fix the pre-flight remediation text (req 2)**: `AppstorePreflight.decide`'s missing-version reason now names the creating step ("its app_store lane creates the version when absent (gh-1519)") instead of implying store-metadata already does it. The pre-flight decision logic itself is unchanged — it caught the hole correctly.
3. **Bounded read-side retry (req 3)**: `appstore_submission_decision` retries the `get_app_store_versions(filter: { platform: })` lookup up to 3 attempts / 20s apart when the version is not yet visible, absorbing ASC read lag after a fresh creation instead of failing instantly (same pattern as the macOS lane's existing 2-attempt preflight probe).

**Previous attempt**: none — fresh bug (not returned from QA/test automation).

# gh-1519: [BUG] Store pipeline cannot create an App Store version: store-metadata runs deliver with skip_app_version_update=true, release-appstore pre-flight dead-ends (v1.0.548 needed manual ASC)

## Description

## Symptom (release v1.0.548, 2026-10-10)

Full release required MANUAL owner intervention: `release-appstore.yml` pre-flight failed 4× with "App Store version 1.0.548 does not exist yet — run store-metadata.yml (metadata_only) first. Nothing was mutated." — but running store-metadata.yml (both legs green) did NOT create the version. Owner created the App Store version by hand in the ASC UI and submitted manually.

## Root cause

The pipeline has NO step that creates a new App Store version:

- `store-metadata.yml` → fastlane `app_store` lane runs `deliver(app_version: store_pubspec_version, skip_app_version_update: true, …)` — the `skip_app_version_update: true` flag tells deliver to never create/update the version record (Fastfile.swift-equivalent at flutter_app/fastlane/Fastfile:554). The run log confirms: "Uploading metadata to App Store Connect for version" with an EMPTY version string.
- `release-appstore.yml` pre-flight (`appstore_submission_decision`, Fastfile:186) correctly refuses when the version is absent — but the remediation it prints is wrong: store-metadata cannot satisfy it.

So the documented remediation loop (`run store-metadata first`) is a dead end; every new version needs a manual ASC click.

## Requirement

1. store-metadata's metadata lanes must CREATE the version when absent: drop `skip_app_version_update: true` (or add an explicit ASC `appStoreVersions` POST via Spaceship before deliver) so `app_version` actually materializes the version record. Applies to both iOS and macOS lanes.
2. Keep the release-appstore pre-flight as-is (it caught the hole correctly) but fix its printed remediation to name the creating step.
3. Verify read-side: after creation, `get_app_store_versions(filter: { platform: })` must find the new version — if ASC read lag/pagination hides freshly created versions, add a bounded retry to the pre-flight rather than an instant fail.

## Acceptance

- Fresh version end-to-end unattended: build-mobile (TF) → store-metadata → release-appstore submits for review with zero manual ASC clicks (release-after-approval stays manual per E5).
- REG: re-running store-metadata on an EXISTING version stays idempotent (metadata update only, no duplicate version error).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…
